context_diary: The account_lookup function retrieves individual user profiles by ID with optional field filtering via "return_fields". When combined with hierarchy traversal that supports pagination through "limit", this enables efficient batch retrieval of specific attributes from large user sets without loading full records. The system returns structured data with match counts, allowing targeted queries for email and other profile fields after initial user discovery. The function supports username-based searches and returns comprehensive profile metadata including account type, status, currency, timestamps, and hierarchical relationships through parent_id.
